native.boot.decision: Keep corrected boot magic, firmware memory map/RSDP, 32 MiB ELF layout. Evaluate VOS3 baremetal_preflight feature checks without importing obsolete boot assumptions; BIOS/UEFI evidence exists, installation remains open.

native.architecture.selected: VOS 5 CPU-local entry, SMP handshake and partial KPTI
native.architecture.decision: Retain current fixes over older global-CR3 implementations. VOS3-Cyber platform stubs are API references, not operational Windows/Linux backends. Full KPTI, x2APIC and AP user workload qualification remain open.

native.memory.selected: VOS 5 per-process roots and CPU-local VMM
native.memory.decision: Do not replace with VOS3 PCID scaffolding explicitly assuming a shared address space. Evaluate Cyber ai_oom bounds logic for integration into real allocation paths; require failure accounting and concurrent isolation tests.

native.scheduler.selected: VOS 5 scheduler and AP readiness fixes
native.scheduler.decision: Keep CPU-local task/entry binding. Compare unretained scheduling policies and qualify actual AP workloads, not only online counts.

native.execution.selected: VOS 5 ELF loader and provisioning/init path
native.execution.decision: Preserve writable-NX copying and user-frame fixes. Review remaining exec/init differences; require fork/clone/signals and program lifecycle evidence.

native.filesystems.decision: Keep signed-model and trusted-key hooks from vos.v1; qualify real storage, path isolation and persistent reboot. Do not confuse boot filesystem diagnostics with installation.

native.drivers.selected: VOS 5 driver tree; VOS3 Hyper-V donor is conditional candidate
native.drivers.decision: Retain native drivers; do not import Hyper-V loopback as a real host transport. Review device initialization and transport differences, then require real device tests.

native.network.selected: VOS 5 network stack plus reviewed policy integration candidate
native.network.decision: Cyber egress_policy.c is missing as a separate module: candidate for scoped deny-first enforcement, not blanket private-network permission. Its port argument is ignored; actual socket/connect linkage must be proven.

native.ipc.decision: Retain frame-owned user stack state and current IPC contracts; validate cross-process isolation and wakeup/fork interactions.

native.security.decision: Retain vos.v1 scope/credential controls. Host policy tests do not establish native enforcement; audit syscall/driver entry paths and revocation.

native.crypto.selected: VOS 5 crypto; VOS3 MMR as additive candidate
native.crypto.decision: Retain current Ed25519/ML-KEM/SHA code pending audit. Review MMR wire format, bounds, key trust and licensing before connecting native and backend evidence ledgers.

native.ai.selected: VOS 5 native AI and slot subsystem
native.ai.decision: Retain canonical, assess donor model/allocator additions without weakening slot ownership. Actual isolated offline inference remains open.

native.tests.selected: VOS 5 native/host kernel tests plus reviewed donor cases
native.tests.decision: Keep actual runtime and production-function tests. Reject obsolete string checks that require broken global roots; missing donor regression cases remain review work.

native.abi.decision: Do not copy donor headers independently of implementation and call sites. Missing PCID/MMR/platform headers are paired candidates, not merge-ready ABI additions.

native.bootloader.selected: Vendored Limine from recorded VOS3 donor
native.bootloader.decision: Use consolidation/limine-dependencies.json provenance and existing BIOS/UEFI build. Review any remaining donor bootloader variants separately; preserve license files.

native.build-and-support.selected: VOS 5 isolated BUILD_DIR and build-config tracking
native.build-and-support.decision: Retain atomic embedding and option invalidation. Alternate donor flavors must not clean shared output or restore placeholder platform claims.

user.libc.decision: Large byte divergence is not automatically functional divergence. Compare upstream provenance, local patches and generated files; preserve runtime ABI compatibility before replacing any libc source.

user.programs.decision: Retain baseline tools/tests; finish compiler-option/header/library dependency tracking. Validate actual binaries in native runtime.

backend.agents.selected: VOS 5 merged vos.v1 + vos/vos4 agent boundaries
backend.agents.decision: Keep local-first routing, sanitation and active-run payload-bound provenance. agent-boundaries.json and focused tests document merged changes; unrelated donor variants remain open.

backend.security.selected: vos.v1 security modules retained in VOS 5
backend.security.decision: Preserve deny precedence, model integrity, scope and DMA/GPU gates. Verify real native/host enforcement rather than accepting host-model tests as hardware proof.

backend.sandbox.decision: Compare missing/differing isolation helpers; require native Windows and resource-boundary tests. Keep fail-closed behavior.

backend.services.selected: VOS 5 services; VOS3 evidence/MMR additions are candidates
backend.services.decision: Keep identity/keyring/P2P/host bridge/local inference service baseline. Evidence bundle, MMR and kernel translator from VOS3 need format, trust, persistence and license review; no duplicate service stack.

backend.core.decision: Retain baseline permission/configuration contracts; compare donor policy/store changes against one identity and storage model.

backend.api.selected: VOS 5 API with merged agents routes
backend.api.decision: Keep existing baseline API contracts and merged agent routes. Review unretained endpoints and local/offline auth; avoid cloud-only mandatory startup.

backend.tests.selected: VOS 5 tests plus donor regressions selected by capability
backend.tests.decision: Keep imported tests but do not equate test-file retention with coverage. Missing donor tests are required review inputs for the corresponding implementations.

backend.mcp.decision: Unify versions, dependencies, authentication and transport with canonical backend; donor SDK/server protocol compatibility remains a gate.

backend.convex.selected: Canonical shared contract; frontend Convex is product data target
backend.convex.decision: Resolve duplicate backend/frontend Convex schema ownership before claiming one data model. Mandatory hosted authentication is incompatible with offline mode.

backend.kernel-bridge.decision: Retain authenticated VBus direction; compare donor protocol/transport variants and test actual host-to-kernel dispatch.

backend.middleware.decision: Keep tenant, authentication and egress boundaries; trace API routes through selected middleware and reconcile donor deltas.

backend.example-projects.decision: Do not treat embedded example applications as required OS runtime services. Preserve their source pending scope/provenance review.

backend.extensions.decision: Retain canonical modules; missing plugins, tools, templates, analytics and workflow variants are explicit per-file review items, not silently rejected.

frontend.data.selected: VOS 5 generated Convex code and membership fixes
frontend.data.decision: Keep real codegen and owner/member authorization fixes. Compare VOS3 local schema edits and other donors; resolve canonical/offline schema before merging.

frontend.product.decision: Do not copy VOS3 local package/config changes blindly. Fix recorded failing suite and align wizard contracts; offline identity/product integration remains open.

desktop.host.decision: Compare Rust/Tauri/config variants; qualify Windows APIs, native/host lifecycle and authenticated transport before release.

sdk.clients.selected: VOS 5 SDKs; VOS3 Windows bridge candidate
sdk.clients.decision: Review missing C# HyperVSocket/client as Windows-specific transport source, with paired driver/protocol validation. Never infer Windows support from loopback tests.

infra.security.selected: VOS 5 security definitions; old reports are historical
infra.security.decision: Regenerate SBOM/scans for selected current dependencies. Old reports/hashes/certification labels do not certify this build.

infra.operations.decision: Compare runner, Kubernetes, provisioning and verification additions. Choose one installation/startup flow; deployment changes require concrete validation.

ci.workflows.selected: Selected AiOS workflows to be integrated explicitly
ci.workflows.decision: Donor CI files missing from canonical are open; reconcile checks with actual build paths and required permissions, not old repository triggers.

documentation.selected: Current design docs plus relocated historical docs
documentation.decision: Preserve historical content/provenance; current CORE_REQUIREMENTS governs release claims. Source release-note local changes need explicit preservation.

system.tests.decision: Map missing donor integration/performance tests to retained capabilities; record real target and artifact scope.

tooling.decision: Keep reproducible build/evidence scripts; reconcile missing source utilities and remove runtime dependence on legacy trees.

licensing.selected: Preserve each selected source license and provenance
licensing.decision: VOS3 includes LicenseRef-VOS3-Sovereign-1.0. Do not relabel donor modules MIT or import them without their applicable license; review mixed licensing before distribution.

root.configuration.decision: Unify startup and dependency locks; do not restore conflicting donor deployment defaults.
